description: This file contains utility functions for displaying and managing progress bars and flow bars in web applications, including functions to flush output buffers, display progress, start/stop flow animations, and update progress bars.

methods.name: progress_bar_flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer if enabled, either via ob_flush or flush.

methods.name: display_flow_bar
methods.description: Displays a horizontal flow bar animation with specified size and delay, initiating the animation.

methods.name: start_flow_bar
methods.description: Starts the flow bar animation by setting up a JavaScript timer to update the bar's background color periodically.

methods.name: destroy_flow_bar
methods.description: Stops the flow bar animation and clears its HTML content.

methods.name: display_progress_bar
methods.description: Displays a progress bar indicating current progress as a percentage.

methods.name: update_progress_bar
methods.description: Updates the progress bar's display to reflect current progress percentage.
